content.title: Miracles: A Preliminary Study
content.author: C. S. Lewis (London: Geoffrey Bles, 1947; chapter 3 revised 1960)
content.note: Chapter 3 states Lewis's argument from reason: that naturalism, by explaining all thought as the product of non-rational causes, undermines the reasoning on which it depends. Lewis's works remain in copyright in the United States; never quoted. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
